tool_args.rationale: The endpoint-matched history gap and coupled transient lag favor a two-state memory ODE. The pilot horizons already bracket the target H of 0.45; the missing evidence is how the hidden memory state relaxes. Acquire finer trajectories to separate memory relaxation from coupling before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter coupled memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five forecast endpoints come from the same history timing, so memory coupling and relaxation time can trade off in the fit. Finer trajectories can distinguish their transient effects.
It predicts the same outcome for matched current states and inputs, so it cannot explain the reported history gap.
It costs less, but tests branch structure rather than resolving the memory transient.
